prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Delay sign-in until after the user picks and names their pet so commitment happens after value discovery. (why: Sign-in has a high drop-off (72.9%) and long mean time (567s). Allowing users to pick their pet first reduces early friction.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Control Guide on Finish: Turn the home welcome screen into a step-by-step interactive stage showing how to move, hide, and interact with the pet. (why: Users are confused after onboarding about how to control or hide their pet, leading to support requests.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Rebuild Welcome Story with Mascot: Redesign the opening story screen into an engaging card view with animated pet mascot preview. (why: The onboarding finish rate is low (17.8%), so building immediate emotional connection on screen 1 increases completion.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning on Sign In: Add explicit visual hint reassuring users that signing in saves pet data across re-installs and device reboots. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, layout] Instant Ready-to-Adopt Pet Choice Grid: Re-layout friend selection into a grid with prominent instant pre-made pets alongside custom creation. (why: Adoption step takes 89s median / 1017s mean, and custom generation fails for some users. Preset options speed up the flow.)
5: [home, wait_info] Time Estimate & Error Safeguard on Waiting Screen: Display explicit rendering timer and helpful tips if pet generation takes longer than expected. (why: Home waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s and adoption bug reports state custom pets fail or stall.)
6: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Notification: Enable desktop notification alert when pet setup finishes while user is waiting. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, suggesting users minimize the app and forget about it.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Copy: Simplify onboarding path descriptions to clearly contrast fast setup versus custom creation. (why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s, indicating hesitation and confusion over options.)
